name: Germany: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site or investigator are left empty, not invented.
Language is German or English; no signature unless the ethics committee or the selected form requires one.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json.

DE-K1.check: Uses the EudraLex template version 2.0 (submissions from 1 September 2026).

The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section is completed, each 'no' section says not applicable.
Who conducts the consent interview matches section 40b(2) AMG (investigator who is a physician or dentist, or a physician or dentist on the trial team).

German additions in the national sections: express consent to data processing (section 40b(6) AMG), qualified translations and communication plan for planned non-German speakers, protected-population consent by the investigator, AMG advance statement for group-benefit research where it applies.
Recruitment routes and first act of recruitment match the recruitment material (K2) and the protocol.

DE-N1.check: One form per German site; covers Annex I point 67 (facilities, equipment, procedures, human resources).
Statements are specific to this protocol (IMP handling, procedures, population, safety management) and mark site capabilities for the site to confirm.
No signature in the CTIS copy (AKEK).
Radiation authorisation documents are planned under N where the 2025 route applies.

DE-S1.check: New and archive sample sections match the protocol and sample plan; at least one is completed.
Analysis, storage, duration, access, coding and transfers match the participant documents and R1.
Future use outside the protocol is answered consistently with the separate secondary-use document (AKEK separate-document rule).

DE-P1.check: States explicitly when no compensation is offered.
Amounts, conditions and recipients identical to every participant document.
Minors, incapacitated adults and breastfeeding women receive only compensation of expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.

DE-R1.check: Contains the German national data-protection confirmation (GDPR opening clauses), or a separate national statement is planned.
Sponsor details match the CTIS application.

DE-M1.check: One CV per principal investigator and site; not older than one year.
Shows professional qualification, relevant clinical experience, trial experience and GCP knowledge.

DE-M2-TRAINING.check: Certificates cover CTR, AMG and GCP according to the German curricular recommendations and are current for the investigator's role.

DE-M2-DOI.check: One declaration per principal investigator and site; economic interests, institutional affiliations and other conditions are answered by the investigator.

DE-N2.check: CTIS lists every planned German site with principal investigator, role and planned participants, matching the M and N documents.

DE-O1.check: Insurer-issued certificate identifies the trial or clearly establishes coverage in Germany.
Cover at least EUR 500,000 per case of death or continuing incapacity for work, proportionate to the risk; or the low-intervention exception applies with its German conditions met.

DE-O2.check: Policy terms provided; insurer name and address, policy number, contact route, main cover and participant obligations match every participant document.

DE-P2.check: Draft contract per German site, without signatures; financial arrangements consistent with P1.

DE-N-RADIATION.check: File set matches the radiation procedure and the current BfArM or PEI route (since 1 July 2025).
